newsitem.title: INDONESIA: HIV-positive Indonesian woman buried at night.
newsitem.headline: HIV-positive Indonesian woman buried at night.

text.p: An Indonesian woman with HIV died and was buried in the middle of the night because local people feared they would be infected the virus, which leads to AIDS, the Republika newspaper reported on Saturday.
It said the woman, a former prostitute named Yanti, died on Tuesday in central Java and was buried late that night.
The newspaper said Yanti died after suffering from fever. It did not elaborate, but said local people still believed that HIV could be transmitted through hand shakes.
The World Health Organisation has said as many as 500,000 Indonesians might have the virus, for which there is no cure.
Indonesia has reported 465 HIV- or AIDS-related deaths, but health workers say those are only the reported cases and the real number could be a hundred times higher.
Indonesia, with nearly 200 milion people, is the world's fourth most populous country. Though predominantly Moslem, it has a thriving sex industry.
